text:
Eli Turner: Quick UX copy question for the delete flow on Deployments -> Instances. Current dialog says:
"Delete deployment? This action cannot be undone."
Feels terse and a bit scary. Screenshot: https://redwood.prod/snapshots/delete-dialog-old.png

Noor Khan: I think we should be explicit about what gets deleted (configs, traffic routing, logs?). Right now users might think it's only the container.

Becca Shaw: Agreed. Also need to decide CTA tone: single destructive button `Delete deployment` vs `Delete` with `Cancel`. For clarity I prefer `Permanently delete deployment` as primary label, but that is long on mobile.

Tomás Alvarez: For mobile we can stack and allow longer copy, but button label should be short. Idea: headline short, body explains consequences, primary CTA `Delete` and a secondary `Export config` or `Cancel`? Not sure about adding export there.

accessibility-bot: Accessibility check: dialogs must set `aria-describedby` pointing to description text and trap focus. Ensure `role=dialog` and confirm keyboard focus on primary action when modal opens is not automatic unless it's destructive. Consider requiring typed confirmation for very destructive actions.

Becca Shaw: Good point — should we require a typed confirmation (type the deployment name) for production deployments only? That reduces accidental deletes.

Noor Khan: Yes but that adds friction for quick dev cleanup. Maybe a rule: require typed confirmation when deployment has traffic > 0 or is marked production. Otherwise simple confirm is fine.

Eli Turner: Copy suggestions from content team:
Variant A (concise):
Headline: `Delete deployment`
Body: `This will remove the deployment and stop routing traffic. This cannot be undone.`
Primary: `Delete` (danger) Secondary: `Cancel`

Variant B (explicit):
Headline: `Permanently delete “{{name}}”?`
Body: `Deleting this deployment will remove its configuration, stop active routing, and delete ephemeral logs. To proceed, type the deployment name below.`
Primary: `Permanently delete` Secondary: `Cancel`

Tomás Alvarez: I prefer Variant B for production-level, Variant A for dev. Also suggest adding a small inline link `Learn more` that opens docs about deletion and rollback options.

Becca Shaw: Tone check: `Permanently delete` feels formal enough. Avoid `Destroy` or `Nuke` in UI copy. Also avoid scary red adjectives in body; keep factual.

accessibility-bot: For the typed-confirmation pattern ensure the input has accessible label and aria-live region for validation errors. If the deletion is queued, announce `Deletion scheduled` with a link to the activity log.

Eli Turner: UX decision proposal:
- If deployment is production (tagged `production` or traffic > 0): show Variant B with typed confirmation (exact name) + `Learn more` link.
- Otherwise: show Variant A with `Delete` primary + `Cancel` secondary.
- Primary button text on mobile: keep short `Delete` but show full `Permanently delete` on desktop when space allows.

Noor Khan: Approve the rule set. For the typed confirm microcopy use: `Type the deployment name to confirm:` and placeholder `my-deployment-23`.

Becca Shaw: I'll update the component spec and include mockups for desktop/mobile and the typed-confirmation state. Also add copy for success toast: `Deployment deleted. View activity`.

design-bot: Component entry `modal-delete-deployment` updated in Figma and docs: https://redwood.prod/docs/components/modals#delete-deployment

Tomás Alvarez: I'll implement the conditional flow and keyboard handling. Ping QA for typed-confirmation validation and i18n length checks.

Eli Turner: Thanks all. Final copy to land in the component doc (Becca) and engineering ticket updated (Tomás). We'll ship with Variant A for dev orgs and Variant B behind `strict_delete_confirmation` flag for prod accounts.
